description: Module/target matrix for the <app> template's .claude layer. modules list the canonical source dir and which runtime targets each applies to. claude + claude-project are always-on; every other target is opt-in via a target flag at install time (scripts/install-claude-runtime.sh --targets=...). The agents, skills and commands in this layer target the Python 3.12 + uv stack (FastAPI, pydantic v2, SQLAlchemy async, Alembic, ruff, mypy strict, import-linter, pytest); their instructions cite the Makefile targets and the src/app/ tree, not a Node toolchain.

hooks._note: Documentary only. The installer HARDCODES install_agents/skills/commands and does not consume this modules block; install_hooks_target() in scripts/install-claude-runtime.sh is the load-bearing wiring, guarded to the claude-project target only, only-if-absent (never clobbers a user settings.json).
